# Liberty Park Dental

> Liberty Park Dental is a comprehensive dental practice in Liberty, Missouri, led by Dr. James J. Dixson, offering cosmetic, general, implant, and specialized treatments including TMJ therapy and sleep apnea relief.

Located at 1508 NE 96th St in Liberty, MO, Liberty Park Dental combines state-of-the-art technology like CEREC same-day crowns and 3D Guided Implantology with personalized patient care. The practice serves the greater Kansas City area with a full range of dental services for families and individuals.

## Specialized Treatments

- [TMJ Therapy – Liberty MO | Liberty Park Dental](https://libertyparkdental.com/dental-services/tmj-therapy): TMJ therapy for jaw pain, headaches, and temporomandibular joint dysfunction
- [Sleep Apnea and Snoring Relief – Liberty MO | Liberty Park Dental](https://libertyparkdental.com/dental-services/sleep-apnea-snoring-relief): Sleep apnea and snoring relief with TAP appliances and CPAP alternatives
- [Teeth Grinding Relief – Liberty MO | Liberty Park Dental](https://libertyparkdental.com/dental-services/teeth-grinding-relief): Teeth grinding and TMJ relief with NTI-tss appliance treatment
- [Laser Therapy – Liberty MO | Liberty Park Dental](https://libertyparkdental.com/dental-services/laser-therapy): Laser therapy for soft tissue treatment and gum disease care
